title: Run the GitHub Actions policy with regal and conftest against all workflow and action YAML
answers: how do I test the .github/policy.rego changes
lint the rego policy with regal
check policy against all GitHub workflows and composite actions
body:
Lint the policy: `bin/regal lint .github/policy.rego`.
Run pre-commit on it: `uv run --only-group lint pre-commit run --files .github/policy.rego`.
Evaluate it: `bin/conftest test --namespace mlflow --policy .github/policy.rego <yaml files>`. The `--namespace mlflow` flag is required because the rules live in that namespace.
Pass every tracked workflow and action YAML file (the PR ran 78 files, producing 3,276 checks), not just the one you edited, since composite-action and workflow steps are both covered.
Also run `git diff --check` for whitespace errors.
applies: Verifying edits to .github/policy.rego in the MLflow repository.
